JournalEntry.title: JournalEntry
JournalEntry.description: A private multimodal reflection journal entry created by an authenticated user.

id.description: Unique idempotent identifier for the entry.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

content.description: Raw text content of the journal entry or transcribed audio.

imageUrl.description: Optional attached image URL or data URI.

source.description: Input modality used to record the reflection.

mood.description: Primary detected or user-confirmed mood label.

confidence.description: Confidence score of the mood classification between 0.0 and 1.0.

concern_flag.description: Conservative indicator if the reflection signals acute distress requiring supportive non-clinical resources.

reflection.description: Concise, empathetic, non-clinical response generated by the Reflection Agent.

action.description: One optional practical next step generated by the Action Agent.

isExcludedFromDigest.description: Whether the user excluded this entry from weekly insight patterns.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the reflection analysis.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the entry was last updated.

MoodCorrection.title: MoodCorrection
MoodCorrection.description: Calibration record when a user corrects an AI mood tag.

originalMood.description: Original mood tag generated by the Mood Agent.

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: User preferences, companion state, and privacy settings.

enablePhotoAnalysis.description: User opt-in/opt-out for photo multimodal reflection.

enableWeeklyPatterns.description: User toggle for weekly digest synthesis.

/users/{userId}/entries/{entryId}.description: Owner-isolated private journal reflections and multimodal analysis results.

/users/{userId}/corrections/{correctionI.description: User-specific mood calibrations for few-shot prompt adaptation.

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: User privacy controls and reflection preferences.
